abstract_summary: Across human history, knowledge has undergone several transitions, from orality to writing and then to digital archives. At each transition, humans established new conventions to preserve knowledge for the new era. Nowadays, as research agents are increasingly deployed for laboratory experiments, knowledge is crossi...

scholarly_quality.concise_summary: The manuscript presents a comprehensive, well-controlled study introducing an active verification paradigm for scientific literature extraction. It combines expert-annotated calibration, rigorous temporal holdout validation, and transparent reporting of failure modes and boundaries.

knowledge it encodes transfers to devices it has not seen. Following
LLM4Mat-Bench's comparison of task-specific and general-purpose
predictors63, we posed a temporally held-out task: predict a device's
efficiencyfromitsrecipealone, thefieldsdescribingthecell, thestack,
the synthesis and the fabrication. Models learn from papers published
uptooneyear,aretunedonthenextandarescoredonceontheyearafter
that. Every performance, stability and bibliographic field is withheld
to reduce target leakage (Methods)64. We compared gradient-boosted
trees65 and a tabular foundation model66, text encoders fine-tuned
on a plain-text serialization of the recipe67–69, and a general-purpose
LLM70 whose training data end before any test paper appeared,

(Fig. 5h). Every trained model clearly beats the predictor that always
guesses the training mean, even though reported efficiencies drift
upward from the training years to the test year. A tree model on a
short list of expert-chosen descriptors already separates good devices
from poor ones. Giving it every recipe field improves it further, so
the full schema that the harness reconstructs carries information that
expert descriptors leave out. The fine-tuned text encoders, which read
the record as a few lines of text and need no feature engineering, do
best of all, and most of their remaining error sits on low-efficiency
devices (Fig. 5d–g; every model is shown in Supplementary Figs. 5
and 6). With the architecture held fixed, formamidinium content and
bandgaprankhighlyamongthedescriptors.

Structurally bounded citation prefixes excluded; ambiguous back matter, body and detected appendices retained where budget permits.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Expert consensus annotations resolved prior to automated verification and temporally held-out physical device efficiency measurements serve as independent benchmarks [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0014, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0046, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0060].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Independent expert adjudication across two curated collections (Collection A and B) for verification accuracy, and out-of-distribution temporal target performance (measured PCE) for downstream device prediction [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0014, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0034, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0060].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Versioned annotation and verification skill policies specifying field semantics, chemical equivalences, and extraction rules [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0012, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0058].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims that domain rules improve verifier agreement, that procedural binding is the primary bottleneck, and that verified records improve out-of-sample device performance prediction are well supported by quantitative experiments [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0021, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0039, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0046].
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation thoroughly measures generator and verifier performance across multiple proprietary and open-weight models, tests rule-based policy interventions with bootstrap statistical significance, and executes an out-of-sample temporal prediction benchmark (forecasting 2025 device PCE from pre-2024 recipe fields) [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0024, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0035, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0046, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0064, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0069].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Expert consensus annotations resolved prior to automated verification and temporally held-out physical device efficiency measurements serve as independent benchmarks [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0014, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0046, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0060].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Independent expert adjudication across two curated collections (Collection A and B) for verification accuracy, and out-of-distribution temporal target performance (measured PCE) for downstream device prediction [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0014, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0034, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0060].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Versioned annotation and verification skill policies specifying field semantics, chemical equivalences, and extraction rules [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0012, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0058].

primary.limitations: The authors clearly acknowledge limitations, including potential self-preference bias when LLM evaluators share model families, the restriction of the schema to champion devices in one material domain, and the lower reliability of complex procedural fields like stability [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0048, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0049].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is rigorously specified, combining a 97-field structured schema, versioned annotation and verification skill policies, and multi-agent roles with explicit parsing and validation boundaries [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0011, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0058, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0059]. Automated verifiers are systematically calibrated against expert ground-truth references annotated across 150 papers (13,350 field decisions) [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0014, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0060].
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a comprehensive, well-controlled study introducing an active verification paradigm for scientific literature extraction. It combines expert-annotated calibration, rigorous temporal holdout validation, and transparent reporting of failure modes and boundaries.
primary.scoped_contribution: VerifiedLab is a multi-agent framework separating experimental record extraction from verification under explicit versioned domain rules, demonstrated by curating 10,258 perovskite solar cell papers with field-level reliability scores and evaluating downstream predictive utility.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a comprehensive, well-controlled study introducing an active verification paradigm for scientific literature extraction. It combines expert-annotated calibration, rigorous temporal holdout validation, and transparent reporting of failure modes and boundaries.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors clearly acknowledge limitations, including potential self-preference bias when LLM evaluators share model families, the restriction of the schema to champion devices in one material domain, and the lower reliability of complex procedural fields like stability [E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0048, E030f9356cb95c4f5-B0049].

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.

research_relevance.value: Directly relevant to autonomous/deep research workflows based on screening evidence.
